_note: Wraith Hunter path (2026-07-12): Runekeeper / Tormentor / Phantom — DRAFT for Game Owner review. Source: C&S PDF pp.91-105. Schema mirrors abilities-warrior.json (Conqueror exemplar). Most entries are resolution:manual because they hinge on systems that do not exist server-side yet (rune reset conditions, Phantom Marks, curse triggers, stances, possession). Runekeeper has no class resource (costs: []). Tormentor resource = curses (per-rest, table 2..8); Phantom resource = energy (100, restores like mana). Phantom Spectral Attacks tiers 2-3 are UNNAMED in the PDF — names taken from the class-abilities.json summary. Two conflicting Spectral Attacks (1) lists exist in the PDF (p.102 bulleted vs p.103 older brace draft) — the p.102 list is used here (question W11). Rune Upgrade (lvl 13) and Perfected Hunter (lvl 20) are folded into each rune's description rather than separate entries. Open questions W1-W16 inline via _question fields.

tormentor.name: Power Absorption (1) use
tormentor._question: W6 — PDF says 'once per short rest' (p.96) but short rests were removed round-4; treated as once per rest of any tier

tormentor.name: Power Absorption (2) use
tormentor._question: W6 — same 'once per short rest' wording (p.97)

abilities.name: Gland Mutations: Regeneration
abilities.description: Whenever you finish a fight, you heal for 2d10 HP per level. Out of combat, once per fight.

abilities.name: Fire Rune
abilities._question: W1, W2 — AP cost of the active is unstated (burning hands cast?)
abilities.description: Passive (while prepared): the first time you hit a creature with an attack, fire shackles attempt to snare it (STR save; lasts up to 3 turns, repeat save at end of each of its turns). Active: cast Burning Hands as a normal caster of your level (WIS spell mod), except targets take half damage on a successful save instead of nothing. The active resets after you damage 5 different creatures (count starts AFTER the cast). From level 13 (Rune Upgrade): dice damage doubled and range +10 ft.

abilities.name: Telekinesis Rune
abilities._question: W1, W2
abilities.description: Passive (while prepared): when moving heavy objects, add the sum of your STR and WIS modifiers to the roll. Active (1 AP): teleport a target within 60 ft to a point of your choice within 30 ft (the destination must be able to hold it — no abyss, steep areas, ladders, etc.). Resets after the teleported target dies or teleports. From level 13: teleport 2 targets (to the same spot, next to each other).

abilities.name: Barrier Rune
abilities._question: W1, W2, W3 — shield = temporary-hp effect? duration unstated
abilities.description: Passive (while prepared): the first time you would take lethal damage, you instead drop to 1 HP. Active (1 AP): gain a temporary shield equal to 3d6 per level. Resets after you deal damage equal to the shield's initial value. From level 13: advantage on all saving throws while the shield is active.

abilities.name: Power Rune
abilities._question: W1, W2 — AP cost of the active is unstated (a normal attack's AP?)
abilities.description: Passive (while prepared): your attacks deal 1d6 additional true damage. Active: a powerful melee blow against a single target — the attack has +5 to the attack roll, doubles the modifier (STR/DEX) damage, and deals true damage. Resets after killing a creature. From level 13: +15 to hit and 3x the modifier damage.

abilities.name: Blink Rune
abilities._question: W1, W2
abilities.description: Passive (while prepared): +1 AC. Active (0 AP): dash up to 30 ft in a direction of your choice, avoiding surface damage (except at the point of arrival) and attacks of opportunity. Resets after moving 6 AP worth of movement. From level 13: twice the amount of dashes, and dashing through an enemy deals 3d10 true damage.

abilities.name: Time Rune
abilities._question: W1, W2
abilities.description: Passive (while prepared): advantage on saving throws that can age you. Active, in combat (0 AP): mark a point in time and space; during your turn within the next 3 rounds, spend 2 AP to return (you only) to that point — teleported to the initial position (or closest available) with the AVERAGE of your current HP and the marked HP. Rune uses, energy, etc. are not returned; if unused for 3 rounds the use is wasted. Out of combat: rewind up to 1 minute (everyone remembers what happened). In combat resets after 1 minute (6 rounds); out of combat resets at long rest. From level 13: return to the MAXIMUM of the two HP values instead of the average, and the out-of-combat rewind is remembered only by you.

abilities.name: Shadow Rune
abilities._question: W1, W2
abilities.description: Passive (while prepared): add your proficiency to stealth checks. Active (1 AP): morph into a shadow for up to 1 minute — you cannot take or deal damage to anyone in the mortal plane, everyone sees you as a distorted dark figure, and you can pass through walls. Resets after 2 entire turns spent hiding. From level 13: completely invisible to mortal-realm creatures (if you want), and your attacks deal 4d10 shadow damage to creatures in other planes.

abilities.name: Apply Oil of Decay
abilities.description: Coat your weapon (1 AP): your attacks halve any HP restoration (not HP increase) of the target for 1 round. Only you can use your oils; a weapon holds one oil at a time; the oil vanishes if the weapon is stowed or dropped.

abilities.name: Apply Oil of Wound
abilities.description: Coat your weapon (1 AP): your attacks wound the target — all additional attacks from physical weapons deal 1d4 extra damage of the same type for 1 round (increased by an additional 1d4 at levels 5, 9, 13, 17). One oil per weapon; vanishes if stowed/dropped.

abilities.name: Apply Oil of Poison
abilities.description: Coat your weapon (1 AP): your attacks deal 1d8 additional poison damage (increased by an additional 1d8 at levels 5, 9, 13, 17). One oil per weapon; vanishes if stowed/dropped.

abilities.name: Oil Additive: Purging
abilities._question: W13 — additives modeled as 0-AP add-ons to the 1-AP basic oil application; confirm total cost stays 1 AP
abilities.description: Add to any basic oil when applying it: your attacks prevent cursed creatures (wendigos, werewolves, ...) from passing on their curse for 1 round.

abilities.name: Oil Additive: Grounding
abilities.description: Add to any basic oil when applying it: your attacks prevent MOST creatures from teleporting to other planes of existence for 1 round.

abilities.name: Oil Additive: Tranquillity
abilities.description: Add to any basic oil when applying it: your attacks prevent creatures from raging or enraging on their upcoming turn, unless they are severely injured.

abilities.name: Oil Additive: Banishing
abilities.description: Add to any basic oil when applying it: your attacks prevent creatures from coming back to life (does not stop spells that recreate the body, like a druid's Restore Body or a lich's self-revive).

abilities.name: Advanced Mutations (pick resistance)
abilities.description: Pick one damage type your foes can deal (except true damage): you become resistant to it. You also meditate 4 hours instead of sleeping (half awake, senses considerably dulled).

abilities.name: Essence Drain: Light
abilities.description: Your weapon attacks deal +X light damage (X = 2 at lvl 1, 4 at 10, 6 at 16, 8 at 20). The bonus increases by X each time you slay your FIRST creature from each unholy tribe (demon, wraith, undead, abomination, cursed-one). From level 4 (Essence Hunger): heal for half the damage dealt by Essence Drain (rounded down).

abilities.name: Essence Drain: Spectral
abilities.description: Your weapon attacks deal +X spectral damage (X = 2 at lvl 1, 4 at 10, 6 at 16, 8 at 20). The bonus increases by X per first kill from each unholy tribe. From level 4 (Essence Hunger): heal for half the Essence Drain damage dealt (rounded down).

abilities.name: Essence Drain: Pure
abilities.description: Your weapon attacks deal +X pure damage (X = 2 at lvl 1, 4 at 10, 6 at 16, 8 at 20). The bonus increases by X per first kill from each unholy tribe. From level 4 (Essence Hunger): heal for half the Essence Drain damage dealt (rounded down).

abilities.name: Mark of the Tormentor
abilities._question: W4 — curses treated as the per-rest casting resource (table 2..8)
abilities.description: Curse a target within 30 ft (spell DC = 8 + prof + WIS): all damage dealt by Essence Drain against the target is tripled for 1 minute. Max 2 marks active (a third ends the oldest). Casting a second mark on a target that already bears one of your active marks costs 2 AP instead of 1.

abilities.name: Mark of Exhaustion
abilities.description: Curse a target within 30 ft: if the target uses all its AP on a turn, it falls prone; if not, its unused AP is lost. Lasts 1 minute. Max 2 marks active; second mark on the same target costs 2 AP.

abilities.name: Mark of Haste
abilities.description: Curse a target within 30 ft: whenever you hit the marked target with an attack, you regain 1 AP (max 3 AP per turn). Lasts 1 minute. Max 2 marks active; second mark on the same target costs 2 AP.

abilities.name: Mark of Pursuit
abilities.description: Choose a target within 30 ft: your MS is doubled and you have advantage on attacks against the marked target, but if you don't damage it with an attack during your turn, you are rooted on your next turn. Lasts 1 minute. Max 2 marks active; second mark on the same target costs 2 AP.

abilities.name: Mark of the Challenger
abilities._question: W5 — 'regain HP equal to its max HP' (capped at your own max?); '[2d8 x level]' = one 2d8 roll times level, or 2d8 per level?
abilities.description: Choose a target within 30 ft: if it dies before the end of the next round, you regain HP equal to its max HP and deal double Essence Drain damage for 1 minute. If it survives, you are stunned for 1 round and take [2d8 x level] true damage. Max 2 marks active; second mark on the same target costs 2 AP.

abilities.name: Absorb: Lesser Wraith
abilities._question: W6 — is any tribe freely usable, or only tribes you have slain?
abilities.description: For up to 1 minute you become partially spectral: pass through solid objects up to 15 cm thick and no larger than Medium (ending your turn inside an object or creature deals 2d6 spectral damage to both); your attacks target the enemy's LOWER armor value (between PA and MA).

abilities.name: Absorb: Lesser Cursed-One
abilities._question: W7 — '+16 at levels 5, 9, 13, and 17': cumulative +16 per threshold?
abilities.description: For up to 1 minute cursed blood courses through you: your melee weapon and unarmed attacks deal +7 damage (bonus increases by +16 at levels 5, 9, 13, and 17).

abilities.name: Absorb: Lesser Abomination
abilities._question: W8 — 'creatures damaged by one of them during the last round': antecedent of 'them' is ambiguous (telepathy targets?)
abilities.description: For up to 1 minute you can telepathically communicate with creatures within 60 ft. If you attack a creature damaged by one of them during the last round, you gain advantage.

abilities.name: Absorb: Lesser Demon
abilities._question: W7 — 'increases to 2d12+2d12 at levels 5, 9, 13, and 17': +1d12 each per threshold, or doubles each threshold (class-abilities summary says doubles)?
abilities.description: For up to 1 minute shadows and flame surround you: at the start of each enemy's turn within 5 ft, it takes 1d12 fire + 1d12 shadow damage (ignores armor). Damage increases at levels 5, 9, 13, and 17 (see question).

abilities.name: Absorb: Lesser Undead
abilities._question: W9 — interacts with the server death system (deathStacks): 'remain at 1 HP instead of dying'; DC reset timing unstated
abilities.description: For up to 1 minute you gain unnatural endurance: if you would die, make a CON save (DC 5, increases by 5 each use) to instead remain at 1 HP. Cannot trigger from light, silver, or true damage.

abilities.name: Power Absorption (2): Wraith
abilities.description: Attack a foe: on a hit deal [your level]d10 psychic damage and force a WILL save or the target is frightened (terrified) for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Power Absorption (2): Cursed-One
abilities.description: Poison a foe: deal [your level]d8 poison damage and force a WIS save or the target becomes mad for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Power Absorption (2): Abomination
abilities.description: Attempt to enslave a creature within 30 ft: CHA save or charmed for up to 3 turns; on a successful save it takes [your level]d12 psychic damage instead.

abilities.name: Power Absorption (2): Demon
abilities.description: Doom a creature for up to 1 minute: WIS save or it takes [your level]d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns and is silenced. It repeats the save at the end of each turn — success ends the silence and halves the fire damage taken each turn.

abilities.name: Power Absorption (2): Undead
abilities.description: Unleash the undead scourge on all creatures within 30 ft: CON save or fall prone (vomiting), become weakened for 1 round (dealing half damage) and decaying for 1 minute (no repeat save, unable to heal). Creatures unable to vomit or already decaying instead take [your level]d12 true damage.

abilities.name: Mark of Confusion
abilities.description: Curse a target within 30 ft: whenever it targets a creature with an attack or spell, it must succeed on a WIS save or attack a random creature within range (if any). Lasts 1 minute. You can have up to 3 marks active, but no more than 2 from Marks of Torment (2).

abilities.name: Mark of Betrayal
abilities.description: Curse a target within 30 ft: for 1 round, all creatures that start their turn within 30 ft of it must make a WIS save or attack it with anything at hand (or move towards it and attack). Up to 3 marks active, max 2 tier-2.

abilities.name: Mark of the Astral Bind
abilities.description: Curse a target within 30 ft: for the next minute, whenever it would dash, be teleported, or be transported to another plane, it is instead returned to its initial location and takes 1d8 true damage per your level. Up to 3 marks active, max 2 tier-2.

abilities.name: Mark of the Gluttony
abilities.description: Curse a target within 30 ft: for 1 minute it can only use 1 AP of movement per turn; any excess AP spent on movement damages it for 6d8 true damage. Up to 3 marks active, max 2 tier-2.

abilities.name: Mark of the Stalker
abilities._question: W10 — 'attacks that use the range cannot miss': auto-hit scope (weapon attacks only? crits?)
abilities.description: Curse a target within 30 ft: for 1 minute you can attack it from up to 60 ft away, and attacks that use this range teleport you to the target and cannot miss. Up to 3 marks active, max 2 tier-2.

abilities.name: Greater Wraith: Possession
abilities._question: W11 — tier-3 powers depend on which greater creature you absorb (kill tracking does not exist server-side); can several be held at once?
abilities.description: Attempt to possess a target (3 AP): CHA save or possessed by you for up to 1 minute — you control it, it stays aware, and forcing directly harmful actions grants it an additional save. On possessing a creature you learn everything it knows (that you can comprehend).

abilities.name: Greater Cursed-One: Curse Form
abilities.description: You control the absorbed curse: enter or exit the cursed form at will (1 AP), and you can pass on the curse if the original creature could. Base form effects: resistance to physical damage, STR and DEX +2, darkvision +60 ft.

abilities.name: Greater Abomination: Body Change
abilities.description: Your body permanently changes depending on the abomination absorbed — one of: scales/hides (+2 AC, +15 PA, +15 MA); glowing muscles (all weapon attacks deal +15 damage); or 2 back tentacles (range 60 ft, each usable once per turn: one deals 100 shadow damage with no attack roll or save for 2 AP; one forces a CHA save or the target is teleported to a point within 30 ft of its location for 2 AP).

abilities.name: Greater Demon: Wings of Fire and Shadow
abilities.description: You grow wings of fire and shadow: flying speed, resistance to fire and shadow, and your weapons deal fire, shadow, or physical damage as you choose per attack. Full effect only if you absorb a demon of both fire AND shadow; otherwise you only gain the fire/shadow half matching the demon.

abilities.name: Greater Undead: Phylactery
abilities._question: W11 — also interacts with the server death system
abilities.description: 1-hour concentration ritual: store part of your soul in a phylactery. The first time you die, you are reborn with full HP from the phylactery and the object is destroyed. After resurrecting you lose this ability, but you can absorb a new (stronger) greater creature to regain a Power Absorption (3) power.

abilities.name: Mark for Death
abilities.description: Curse a target within 30 ft: ALL damage dealt against it is doubled until the start of your next turn. You can have one tier-3 mark besides the 3 marks you can already have.

abilities.name: Mark for Shatter
abilities.description: Curse a target within 30 ft: all damaging abilities it uses deal only half damage for 1 round. You can have one tier-3 mark besides the 3 marks you can already have.

abilities.name: Ethereal Form
abilities._question: W12 — mapped to the existing 'ethereal' effect (physical x0.5 / magical x2.0); toggling back removes it; the free-transform-per-turn tracking and the attacked-in-both-forms rebate stay manual
abilities.description: Switch between Mortal and Ethereal Form. The first transformation each turn costs 0 AP; each additional one that turn costs 1 AP. Ethereal Form: resistant to physical damage, vulnerable to magic damage, your attacks deal spectral damage. If you attack at least once in each form during your turn (hit or miss), your next transformation that turn costs 0 AP. From level 14 (Plane Shifter) all transformations are free. Level 20 (True Phantom): you exist in both planes — resistant to physical by default, NOT vulnerable to magic, all abilities usable regardless of form, attacks deal physical or spectral at your choice.

abilities.name: Spectral Craft
abilities.description: Create fist-sized, valueless, mechanically simple magical objects at will (detectable/dispellable as magic). 1-hour ritual: create a Spectral Weapon with the form and stats of any weapon of your level or lower — use any stat for attack and damage rolls, ignore the heavy property, deals physical damage in Mortal Form and spectral in Ethereal Form, does not count as magical vs resistances, dissipates if another creature wields it, persists until dismissed or replaced.

abilities.name: Decoy Hit
abilities._question: W14 — energy is stated to be spent on the MORTAL activation; does the Ethereal (mark-consuming) half cost energy too?
abilities.description: Declared on an attack that hits (after seeing the roll). Mortal Form: halve the attack's damage (before armor and resistances) and apply a Mark to the target. Ethereal Form: consume the target's Mark to make the attack a critical hit. One Mark per target (new Marks overwrite); Marks persist until consumed or replaced. Save DC for Spectral Attacks = 8 + proficiency + your Spectral Weapon stat modifier.

abilities.name: Spectral Afterblow
abilities.description: Declared on an attack that hits. Mortal Form: if you have at least 1 AP remaining, spend 1 AP to apply a Mark to the target. Ethereal Form: consume the Mark to gain 3 AP.

abilities.name: Ghost Blink
abilities.description: Mortal Form: your attacks gain +30 ft range and become projectiles until one hits; when an attack hits, the effect ends and the target is Marked. Ethereal Form: consume the Mark to teleport to the nearest unoccupied space adjacent to the target — 0 AP, no attacks of opportunity, no interaction with surfaces, terrain, or hazards.

abilities.name: Duality Verdict
abilities._question: W14, W15 — near-duplicate of tier-2 Vital Strike; confirm both exist. Self-damage on the ethereal half is per the text
abilities.description: Mortal Form (2 AP): heal 2d10 HP per level and apply a Mark to the last creature that damaged you. Ethereal Form (1 AP): consume the Mark to deal true damage to BOTH you and the target equal to the amount healed by this ability; if you do not spend the AP, the Mark is consumed and nothing happens.

abilities.name: Ravaging Stance
abilities._question: W16 — entering a stance from normal appears FREE; only early stance-to-stance switching costs 25% of total energy and stance-to-normal costs 50%; confirm (and confirm % of MAX energy, i.e. 25/50 flat)
abilities.description: Enter for 3 turns (0 AP, then you return to normal): double all modifier and dice damage you deal, but you cannot benefit from any healing or shielding. Early switch to another stance: 25% of total energy; early return to normal: 50%.

abilities.name: Precision Stance
abilities.description: Enter for 3 turns (0 AP): double your proficiency for all attack rolls, but your speed is halved. Early switch: 25% energy; early return to normal: 50%.

abilities.name: Bloodthirst Stance
abilities._question: W16 — 'must always end your turn in the other ethereal form than you have started it' read as: must switch Mortal/Ethereal each turn
abilities.description: Enter for 3 turns (0 AP): heal for 50% of the damage you deal, but you must end each turn in the opposite form (Mortal/Ethereal) from the one you started it in — failing ends the stance and deals 25% of your max HP as true damage to you. Early switch: 25% energy; early return: 50%.

abilities.name: Suspend
abilities.description: Mortal Form: your attack makes the target float 20 ft above the ground and Marks it — it cannot move in any direction and is considered rooted, until the end of your next turn. Ethereal Form: your attack strikes the target down, dealing +1d4 bonus damage per level and knocking it prone if it was suspended in the air. (Tier-2 name from summary; unnamed in the PDF.)

abilities.name: Vital Strike
abilities._question: W15 — near-duplicate of tier-1 Duality Verdict (same heal/true-damage mechanic at 3x the energy); confirm intentional
abilities.description: Mortal Form (2 AP): heal 2d10 HP per level and Mark the target that last damaged you. Ethereal Form (2 AP): consume the Mark — you take the amount healed as damage and the target takes the same amount as true damage. (Tier-2 name from summary; unnamed in the PDF.)

abilities.name: Spectral Sweep
abilities.description: Mortal Form (1 AP): spin your weapon — all targets in reach make a STR save or are pushed back 15 ft; only targets that FAIL the save are Marked. Ethereal Form (3 AP): consume ALL Marks to pull every marked target next to you and make one free attack against each. (Tier-2 name from summary; unnamed in the PDF.)

abilities.name: Spectral Eyes
abilities.description: Peek into the spectral realm without fully transforming: only your eyes become ghostly — you see beings in the spectral realm and can use Sense Spirits, with none of the Ethereal Form modifiers.

abilities.name: Spiritbane Stance
abilities._question: W16 — do the doubled energy costs include stance-switching costs?
abilities.description: Enter for 3 turns (0 AP): your weapon attacks lower the target's CHA modifier by 1 (stays lowered while the stance is active, max -5); advantage on CHA and WIS saves; ALL your energy costs are doubled. Early switch: 25% energy; early return: 50%.

abilities.name: Angelic Stance
abilities.description: Enter for 3 turns (0 AP): immune to being turned/cursed, poisoned, plagued, decayed, and vomiting; your weapon counts as magical for overcoming resistances and armor; your PA and MA drop to 0. Early switch: 25% energy; early return: 50%.

abilities.name: Steady Mind Stance
abilities.description: Enter for 3 turns (0 AP): immune to mind-altering effects and to being teleported to other planes against your will; your INT and WIS modifiers are doubled for checks and saves; disadvantage on STR, DEX, and CON saves. Early switch: 25% energy; early return: 50%.

abilities.name: Spectral Impale
abilities.description: Mortal Form (3 AP): thrust your weapon into the earth — spectral copies spring out and impale all enemies within 20 ft (separate attack roll each, normal attack damage), Marking the ones hit. Ethereal Form (0 AP): send ghostly copies of yourself to each Marked target; they last until the end of your turn and mimic your attacks on their assigned target at half damage. (Tier-3 name from summary; unnamed in the PDF.)

abilities.name: Spectral Recall
abilities.description: Mortal Form (0 AP): mark the point in space where you are standing. Ethereal Form: teleport to the marked point (or nearest available space) — for 0 AP teleport only, or for 3 AP also create a 15 ft radius spectral explosion centered where you stood before teleporting, dealing 30d10 spectral damage (CON save for half). (Tier-3 name from summary; unnamed in the PDF.)

abilities.name: Spirit Banish
abilities._question: W17 — banishment to the spectral plane has no server-side plane/encounter model; while banished the target suffers the ethereal condition when interacting with you
abilities.description: Mortal Form (1 AP): force the target to make a CHA save, Marking it on a fail. Ethereal Form (0 AP, applied on an attack that hits): consume the Mark to banish the target to the spectral plane for up to 1 minute — while you are in Ethereal Form you and it can interact (it also suffers the ethereal condition), but other creatures cannot interact with it at all. (Tier-3 name from summary; unnamed in the PDF.)
